principles: Every recall addition ships with must-fire AND must-not-fire smoke cases in the same commit (RED-first both directions)
Clause structure, not raw proximity or word counts, decides chain reachability (B-2c03 F-012 lesson)
Verb vocabulary is precision-bound: passive voice, follow-up objects, or delivery qualifiers - never bare change verbs
The sanitizer and clause taxonomy settled in B-2c03 stay untouched beyond the two declared chain tweaks
Deterministic lexical processing only - a DONE gate must be reproducible
drivers: Five recall classes were live-verified as silent bypasses during nine codex host-B rounds - each is a narrowed delivery that can reach DONE unconfirmed
B-2c03 just closed the false-positive direction; additions must not force honest summaries to paraphrase again
All 22+ B-2c03 pinned smoke cases must pass unchanged (convergence statement)

options.name: targeted-lexical-additions
pros: Matches the five verified classes exactly
Each addition independently pinnable both directions
Stays inside the B-2c03 convergence design and scope boundary
cons: Vocabulary remains a curated list that future classes will extend
Bounded adverb windows can miss exotic insertions beyond two tokens

options.name: broad-verb-and-window-expansion
cons: Bare removed/dropped/cut flood routine change descriptions with false positives
Open windows revive the F-012 proximity failure class
Directly contradicts the user-confirmed precision design

options.name: semantic-classification
cons: Explicitly excluded by the scope boundary

rationale: The five classes are precisely characterized with verified sentences; targeted additions close them while the both-directions pinning discipline and the inherited convergence statement keep the precision/recall treadmill closed. The broad and semantic options both reopen failure classes B-2c03 spent nine cross-vendor rounds closing.

preMortem.scenario: A new verb form fires on routine change descriptions across many stories
preMortem.trigger: A bare or under-constrained verb (removed, dropped, cut) slips into the vocabulary without its qualifier binding
preMortem.consequence: Honest DONE summaries get blocked repo-wide; authors paraphrase and trust in the gate erodes (the exact B-d6a0 pain, reversed)
preMortem.mitigation: Every verb is passive-bound, follow-up-bound, or qualifier-bound; bare forms are pinned must-not-fire in the smoke; reviewer lanes probe with routine-change sentences

preMortem.scenario: An adverb window bridges a sentence or clause boundary
preMortem.trigger: The window connector accepts sentence punctuation (the not-documented-period-Yet-covered shape)
preMortem.consequence: Unrelated sentences combine into phantom triggers - the F-012 class returns through the new windows
preMortem.mitigation: Window connectors use the dot-not-before-whitespace rule; a sentence-boundary must-not-fire control is pinned; windows are bounded to two tokens

preMortem.scenario: A vocabulary addition interacts with the sanitizer to double-fire or silently swallow
preMortem.trigger: A new verb phrase overlaps a stripped token boundary (URL or file name stripped mid-phrase)
preMortem.consequence: Either false positives from residue or false negatives when the verb sits inside the stripped span
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-004 interaction audit probes each addition against every strip class; the URL-descoped interaction pin covers the stripped-subject shape

preMortem.trigger: An alternation change reorders or shadows an existing branch of the trigger regex
preMortem.consequence: A closed false-positive or false-negative class silently reopens
preMortem.mitigation: The full 22+ pinned B-2c03 cases run in the same smoke; cross-vendor codex host-B review re-probes the closed classes before quorum
